name: Vermin Whisperer
body:
Vermin Whisperer (Su)
Source Ultimate Magic pg. 33
You can use your wild empathy ability on vermin. When you do so, you impart a modicum of implanted intelligence on the vermin, allowing you to interact with vermin as if they were animals. Vermin whisperer functions only on vermin that are mindless or have an Intelligence score of 2 or lower.
